caption: These easy toddler salmon patties come together with just a few simple ingredients and are packed with protein, healthy fats, and veggies! 🥔🥦🐟 Perfect for meal prep, lunch, or a quick weeknight dinner. ✨ You’ll need: • 1 large steamed potato • 1 medium cooked salmon fillet, flaked with a fork (check carefully for any bones and remove them) • 3–4 steamed broccoli florets, finely chopped • 1/4 cup shredded cheese • 1 egg • A sprinkle of garlic powder 🥣 Directions: Mash everything together until well combined. Form into small, flat patties. Heat a little olive oil in a pan over low to medium heat and cook until both sides are golden brown. Let cool before serving.
